data.name: Fulwa
data.gender_notes: Fulwa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fulwa means 'The Radiant One'. This beautiful name is derived from the root words 'Fawla' meaning brightness, radiance, and splendor. The name Fulwa carries the meaning “The Radiant One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fulwa usually hope their child will grow to embody the radiant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the light of faith and wisdom.
data.etymology: Fulwa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Radiant One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fulwa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: فلوة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الزهرة أو الوردة، يدل على الجمال والرقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فلوة مشتق من الفل، وهو نوع من أنواع الزهور في اللغة العربية، ويدل على الجمال والرقة. استخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة العربية لوصف الجمال والأنوثة، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرتبطة بالطبيعة.

in_urdu.name: فلوہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت نام، معنی ہے زہرہ یا گل، خوبصورتی اور نرمی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام فلوہ عربی زبان کے فل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پھول یا زہرہ. یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور نرمی کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا تعلق خوبصورتی اور فطرت سے ہے.

in_hindi.name: फुलवा
in_hindi.meaning: एक सुंदर नाम, अर्थ है फूल या गुल, सौंदर्य और कोमलता की प्रतीक
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम फुलवा अरबी भाषा के 'فل' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है फूल या गुल. यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सौंदर्य और कोमलता की निशानी के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है, और इसका संबंध सौंदर्य और प्रकृति से है.

in_english.name: Fulwa

In modern usage, Fulwa remains a popular choice for its lovely meaning and cultural resonance.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Fulwa represents the inner light that every human being holds within them. It is a reminder of the divine presence that illuminates our paths and guides us towards the truth. The name 'Fulwa' is also associated with the light of Allah, the Almighty God, as mentioned in the Qur'an: "Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His Light is as if there were a Niche and within it a Lamp: the Lamp enclosed in Glass: the Glass as it were a shining star from Sidratul-Muntakah. Light upon Light! Allah guides to His Light with whom He pleases. And Allah sets forth parables for men, and Allah has knowledge of all things." [Al-Qur'an 24:35] Thus, Fulwa symbolizes not only physical radiance but also the inner light that reflects the divine presence and illuminates the hearts of those who believe.
